blocks.text: ZAMBOANGA CITY — A police special task group is pursuing leads and gathering forensic evidence in the fatal ambush of a Basilan-based judge who was gunned down while heading to the port here on Thursday, a regional police official said. Lt. Col. Shellamie Chang, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 9 (PRO 9), said the Special Investigation Task Group (SITG) is currently analyzing closed-circuit television (CCTV) footage, examining the victim’s electronic devices, and interviewing witnesses, family members, and court staff.
